metadata.code_revision_note: Captured from the host checkout at the time run_eurusd_backtest.py was committed and this preservation step was run. The backtest itself (2026-08-14 22:00 UTC) ran before that commit, while the driver script was still untracked -- so this revision identifies the code as re-committed/preserved, not a run-time-embedded stamp.
metadata.sample_stride_note: run_eurusd_backtest.py samples every Nth chronological candidate (SAMPLE_STRIDE=15) out of the full resolved EURUSD corpus -- 4,542 is a stride-15 subsample, not the full corpus.
metadata.timeframe: M5 entry signals over the full point-in-time corpus (multi-timeframe strategy context)
metadata.top_k_note: run_eurusd_backtest.py passes top_k=100 as a literal, which matches similarity._DEFAULT_TOP_K today but is not imported from it. The live entry-decision path uses a smaller, separately-declared entry_intelligence._SIMILARITY_TOP_K=50 for its live hot path -- this backtest used the module's own default, not the live value.
metadata.walk_forward_semantics: Each candidate's evidence is restricted to analogs strictly earlier than entry_time - purge_window (purge_window=12:00:00, imported from walk_forward._PURGE_WINDOW). The script calls similarity.similarity_statistics/entry_intelligence directly and does not invoke walk_forward.run_walk_forward's own train/OOS split machinery -- only the purge-window constant is shared.
